accepted_answers.name: six (incumbent, keep)
accepted_answers.why: A single-file, dependency-free compatibility shim with a stable frozen API; no wheel replaces a niche compat layer without adding a dependency for zero gain.

notes: Baseline commit c8e394065cd541a16c040515dc0afb85cf22a7c3. Baseline suite: 196 passed, 3 skipped, stdlib only, ~1s (temp venv). Surveyed and rejected: `future`/`past` (heavier, less adopted, no gain for a frozen shim), vendoring (copies a stable file for no reason), dropping py2-compat shims (out of scope for the library's contract). Verdict: keep hand-rolled with this justification. accepted_answers names the incumbent per keep-yours convention (empty expected_wheels).
problem: A niche single-file compatibility shim has no good wheel substitute; any swap adds dependency weight for zero gain.

verify.test_command: python -m pytest -q --json-report --json-report-file=<tmp>/rep-six.json test_six.py (suitevenv python, run from repo root)
